headlines.summary: 摩根大通交易部门日前警告称，周三公布的美国7月份CPI报告可能会使标普500指数当日上下波动高达2%。由于CPI报告公布时间距离美联储9月政策会议仅几周，因此此次数据公布意义重大。美联储主席凯文·沃什已明确表示，该央行对2%通胀目标的承诺是绝对的。 摩根大通提前推演了五种不同的反应情景。其中最有可能出现(概率高达40%)的结果是，核心通胀率在0.2%至0.25%之间，预计这将推动标普500指数上涨0.25%至0.75%。 同时，尾部风险也十分显著：核心CPI数据高于0.3%(概率仅为5%)可能引发1.5%至2.5%的股市抛售；而核心CPI数据低于0.15

headlines.title_en: US July CPI due tomorrow! JPMorgan outlines five scenarios
headlines.summary_en: JPMorgan's trading desk warned that Wednesday's US July CPI report could move the S&P 500 by up to 2% intraday. With the release coming just weeks before the Fed's September policy meeting, the data is highly significant. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has made clear the central bank's commitment to its 2% inflation target is absolute. JPMorgan ran five scenarios in advance. The most likely outcome (with up to 40% probability) is core inflation between 0.2% and 0.25%, which is expected to lift the S&P 500 by 0.25% to 0.75%. Tail risks are also notable: core CPI above 0.3% (only 5% probability) could trigger a 1.5% to 2.5% equity selloff, while core CPI below 0.15% could...

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 澳洲联储料维持利率不变 但强调手中仍握着“大棒”
headlines.summary: 机构分析称，澳洲联储将于北京时间12:30公布政策会议结果，这很可能是一场“面面俱到”的沟通大师课。行长米歇尔·布洛克看起来大概率会宣布维持官方现金利率不变，但同时会警告——她手中仍握有大棒，未来利率仍可能上调。澳洲联储一方面会对近期通胀降温的迹象表示欢迎，另一方面也会对房价下跌的速度感到一定担忧。不过，抗击价格压力的战斗尚未取得胜利，而中东战事很可能轻易成为另一轮供给冲击的源头。

headlines.title_en: RBA expected to hold rates steady but stresses it still holds the 'big stick'
headlines.summary_en: Institutional analysis says the RBA's policy decision due at 12:30 Beijing time is likely to be a 'masterclass' in comprehensive communication. Governor Michele Bullock is expected to hold the official cash rate steady but warn that she still holds a big stick and rates could still rise. The RBA will welcome recent signs of cooling inflation while expressing some concern over the pace of house price declines. However, the battle against price pressures is not yet won, and Middle East hostilities could easily become another source of supply shocks.

headlines.title: 综合多重因素，赴港投保性价比被重新评估
headlines.summary: 近日调研获悉，受“香港保单收益征税”消息影响，一些消费者正重新评估赴港投保性价比。已有多位香港保险营销员接到客户咨询，他们明显感受到市场正在降温。此外，随着人民币汇率不断升值，赴港投保的预期收益有所降低。在业内人士看来，受税收、汇率等因素影响，短期内消费者赴港投保将会降温，尤其是投资型保险产品受影响更大。对于消费者而言，未来赴港投保应综合考虑产品、汇率、合规、服务等多方面因素。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Weighing multiple factors, cost-effectiveness of Hong Kong insurance purchases reassessed
headlines.summary_en: Recent research indicates that amid news of 'taxation on Hong Kong policy income,' some consumers are reassessing the cost-effectiveness of buying insurance in Hong Kong. Multiple Hong Kong insurance agents have received client inquiries and feel the market is cooling. Additionally, as the RMB appreciates, expected returns from Hong Kong policies have declined. Industry insiders believe that due to tax, FX, and other factors, consumer demand for Hong Kong insurance will cool in the short term, especially for investment-linked products. Consumers should weigh product, currency, compliance, and service factors comprehensively going forward. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 中国商务部: 自巴西进口的牛肉已达到保障措施规定数量的90%
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公告称，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于2026年8月10日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家（地区）规定数量的90%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: China's MOFCOM: Beef imports from Brazil have reached 90% of the volume specified under safeguard measures
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imports from Brazil under the safeguard measures had reached 90% of the quota specified in Announcement No. 87 of 2025 as of August 10, 2026. According to that announcement, once imports hit 100% of the specified quota, a 55% tariff will be imposed on top of current applicable rates starting from the third day thereafter.

headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.

headlines.title_zh: 香港商业地产投资增长跑赢亚太同业市场
headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行称，香港商业地产投资在第二季度增长超过一倍，达到31亿美元，成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场，这得益于零售和办公楼交易的强劲增长以及低基数效应。与去年同期相比129%的增幅超过了新加坡等其他表现最佳的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 麦当劳资产在香港零售物业市场疲软中何以脱颖而出？
headlines.summary_zh: 在麦当劳开始出售其自营香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近半数物业组合找到了买家，尽管该市零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合最初估值约为30亿港元（合3美元）。

headlines.title: 金融产品网络营销新规9月底起实施，保险业提前摸排整治账号端乱象
headlines.summary: 金融产品网络营销最严监管规定——《金融产品网络营销管理办法》将于9月30日起实施。记者从相关渠道获悉，针对办法对保险机构网络营销划定的“硬杠杠”，监管部门正在主动摸排整治账号端乱象、厘清市场生态，为新规落地铺路。受访人士表示，随着监管部门整治深入和办法落地实施，“机构担责+人证合一+可回溯”将是保险网络营销的最终走向。从长期看，这有利于降低消费者的信任成本，激活真实保险需求，推动保险机构业务质量、续保率等长期指标提升。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New financial product online marketing rules take effect end-September, insurance industry conducts early screening of account-end irregularities
headlines.summary_en: The strictest regulation on online marketing of financial products—the 'Measures for the Administration of Online Marketing of Financial Products'—will take effect on September 30. Sources say regulators are proactively investigating and rectifying account-related irregularities to pave the way for the new rules. Interviewees suggest that as regulatory scrutiny deepens and the measures are implemented, 'institutional accountability + identity verification + traceability' will be the ultimate direction for insurance online marketing. In the long run, this will lower consumer trust costs, activate genuine insurance demand, and improve long-term metrics like business quality and renewal rates. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 2026年7月智利碳酸锂出口数量为2.34万吨 硫酸锂出口数量为0.77万吨
headlines.summary: 据智利海关出口数据显示，2026年7月份智利碳酸锂总出口2.34万吨，环比增加8.31%，同比增加11.63%。其中出口到中国15051吨，环比减少0.29%，同比增加10.4%；出口到韩国4023吨，环比增加6.92%，同比减少34.18%；出口到日本1589吨，环比增加1.29%，同比增加158.1%。2026年7月份智利硫酸锂总出口0.77万吨出口至中国，环比减少48.38%，同比减少25.75%。（SMM）

headlines.title_en: In July 2026, Chile's lithium carbonate exports totaled 23,400 tons; lithium sulfate exports totaled 7,700 tons.
headlines.summary_en: Chile customs export data shows July 2026 lithium carbonate exports totaled 23,400 mt, up 8.31% MoM and 11.63% YoY. Of that, 15,051 mt went to China, down 0.29% MoM but up 10.4% YoY; 4,023 mt to South Korea, up 6.92% MoM but down 34.18% YoY; and 1,589 mt to Japan, up 1.29% MoM and 158.1% YoY. Chile's July lithium sulfate exports totaled 7,700 mt to China, down 48.38% MoM and 25.75% YoY. (SMM)
